definitions.rationale: This is the singleton base equation defining the mathematical summary minPrefix on a one-element non-empty list.
This is the recursive equation defining minPrefix: a minimum prefix is either the head alone or the head plus a non-empty prefix of the tail.
definitions.text:
rule minPrefix(cons(H, cons(J, T)))
    => intMin(H, H +Int minPrefix(cons(J, T)))

definitions.rationale: This is the singleton base equation defining the mathematical summary minSubarray on a one-element non-empty list.
This is the recursive equation defining minSubarray as the minimum of a subarray wholly in the tail and a prefix beginning at the head.
definitions.text:
rule minSubarray(cons(H, cons(J, T)))
    => intMin(minSubarray(cons(J, T)),
              minPrefix(cons(H, cons(J, T))))

definitions.rationale: This rule is a macro expansion of the named proof term solutionFunctions into the two concrete function closures copied from solution.mpy.
definitions.text:
rule solutionFunctions =>
      ("min_prefix_sum" |-> closure(Params("nums"),
        If(Compare(Call(Name("len"), Name("nums")), CmpOp("==", Int(1))),
          Return(Subscript(Name("nums"), Int(0))),
          .Stmts)
        Assign(Name("tail_min"),
          Call(Name("min_prefix_sum"),
            Subscript(Name("nums"), Slice(Int(1), NoBound, NoBound))))
        Return(Call(Name("min"),
          Subscript(Name("nums"), Int(0)),
          BinOp("+", Subscript(Name("nums"), Int(0)), Name("tail_min"))))))
      ("minSubArraySum" |-> closure(Params("nums"),
        If(Compare(Call(Name("len"), Name("nums")), CmpOp("==", Int(1))),
          Return(Subscript(Name("nums"), Int(0))),
          .Stmts)
        Assign(Name("tail_min"),
          Call(Name("minSubArraySum"),
            Subscript(Name("nums"), Slice(Int(1), NoBound, NoBound))))
        Assign(Name("prefix_min"),
          Call(Name("min_prefix_sum"), Name("nums")))
        Return(Call(Name("min"), Name("tail_min"), Name("prefix_min")))))
